zh.coverageTitle: 模型与 Key 覆盖情况
zh.readCoverage: 读取 Key 覆盖情况
zh.coverageHint: 只读取完整 Key 目录和已保存的模型规则，不调用上游。计数结合渠道、Key、母凭据状态及模型权限；不代表推理实测结果或实时健康。
zh.modelUnion: 有效模型并集 {{count}} 项 · 已读取全部 {{total}} 个 Key
zh.partialUnion: 已确认模型并集至少 {{count}} 项 · {{failed}} / {{total}} 个 Key 未能读取
zh.partialCoverage: {{count}} 个 Key 查询失败，覆盖数暂不完整；未知不会显示为 0，请重试。
zh.supportingKeys: 符合规则的 Key 数
zh.profileInvalid: 请填写名称、公开 HTTPS 地址和新账户查询凭证。上游用户 ID 最长 64 字符，数值最多 12 位小数，币种仅接受字母、数字或下划线。
zh.channelTableHint: 渠道规则列表中的本地开关仅编辑渠道权限，Key 的最终有效状态请在各 Key 模型管理中查看。

alert.low_balance: 上游剩余额度低于设置阈值。
alert.exhausted: 上游已明确报告额度耗尽。
alert.expiring: 上游额度或订阅即将到期。
alert.query_failed: 上游额度查询连续失败，请检查查询配置。

zh.httpsHint: 使用公开 HTTPS 地址，不携带用户名、密码、查询参数或片段。

usageError.profile_required: 请配置并绑定共享账户查询凭证。
usageError.unsupported_endpoint: 该上游没有提供此查询接口。
usageError.upstream_auth: 上游拒绝查询凭证，请检查授权或重新配置。
usageError.upstream_rate_limited: 上游限制查询频率，请稍后重试。
usageError.upstream_unavailable: 上游暂时不可访问，最后成功结果已保留。
usageError.invalid_upstream_response: 上游返回内容无法识别，未替换原快照。
usageError.configuration_changed: 查询期间配置发生变化，请按新配置重试。
usageError.refresh_in_progress: 已有刷新任务进行中，正在显示最近一次结果。

zh.channelModelRefreshHint: 未单独保存规则的 Key 使用此刷新默认值。关闭表示不在后台刷新；间隔为 300 至 2592000 秒。
zh.keyModelRefreshHint: 首次保存后使用独立刷新设置，关闭会覆盖渠道默认值。模型继承模式不改变此设置；间隔为 300 至 2592000 秒。
zh.usageIntervalHint: 关闭表示不在后台刷新；开启后可设置 60 至 604800 秒。
zh.channelUsageHint: 尚未保存独立查询设置的 Key 继承这里的平台、共享账户、刷新和低额设置。
zh.usageInherited: 当前继承渠道默认值。保存后成为此 Key 的独立设置。
zh.usageOverride: 当前使用此 Key 的独立设置，关闭自动刷新也会覆盖渠道默认值。
zh.keyPolicy: 此 Key 的模型规则
zh.channelPolicyHint: 按映射后的上游模型原名限制整个渠道。任何 Key 都不能放行渠道已禁止的模型；渠道已发布模型范围仍然生效。
zh.keyPolicyHint: 默认继承渠道。规则匹配上游模型原名，区分大小写；手动停用优先，并同时受渠道和母凭据限制。
zh.emptyAllowlist: 每行一个模型名。空白名单会禁止全部模型。
zh.namesHint: 每行一个上游原名，区分大小写。继承模式下名单不增加限制。
zh.model: 上游模型 / 公开名称
zh.searchModels: 搜索上游或公开模型名
zh.noModels: 没有匹配的模型，可获取上游清单或手动添加。
zh.discoveryEvidence: 上游列出模型不代表已验证推理调用。获取清单不自动替换规则；新模型需要明确加入允许名单，且不能突破渠道发布范围。
zh.emptyDiscovery: 上游本次成功返回空清单。原有本地规则保持不变；如需全部禁止，请明确保存空白名单。
zh.autoAddHint: 仅对白名单生效，保留手动停用项。
zh.intervalHint: 关闭表示不在后台刷新；开启后可设置 60 至 2592000 秒。
zh.discoveryFailed: 获取失败，原有发现结果和本地规则已保留。
zh.error: 操作失败，填写内容已保留，请重试。
zh.conflict: 配置已被其他操作更新。重新读取后再编辑；当前填写不会自动覆盖新版本。
zh.forbidden: 当前账号没有管理权限。
zh.invalid: 请检查模型名称、名单数量、数值格式或刷新间隔。
zh.sharedHint: 此余额属于上游共享账户，绑定的多个 Key 使用同一份快照，不能重复相加。
zh.unsupportedUsage: 当前平台或查询方式不支持读取额度，可检查下方的平台与账户配置。
zh.failedUsage: 上游查询失败，最后成功结果仍保留；未知或陈旧数据不会显示为 0。
zh.usageHint: 这里显示上游原始作用域与计量单位，与本站用户钱包及本地累计扣费分别计算。后台刷新失败不会停用 Key。
zh.providerHint: 管理平台与推理协议独立配置；兼容 OpenAI 接口不代表使用 New API 平台。
zh.profileMissing: 原共享账户配置不可用，请重新选择。
zh.conversionHint: 仅在已确认上游换算规则时填写，留空保留原始单位。
zh.lowThresholdHint: 与返回的剩余额度单位一致；留空关闭提醒，不使用本站钱包单位推算。
zh.pauseExhausted: 确认额度耗尽时临时暂停
zh.pauseHint: 仅使用新鲜且明确的耗尽结果；未知、失败或陈旧快照不触发暂停。恢复后由系统解除额度暂停，手动停用状态保持独立。
zh.profileHint: 使用独立的只读查询凭证，可供同一上游账户的多个 Key 复用。凭证加密保存，保存后不回显。
zh.secretPreserved: 已配置凭证。留空保留原值；填写则替换。
zh.secretRequired: 新建必须填写只读查询凭证。
zh.deleteProfileHint: 删除后不可继续查询。仍有 Key 引用时服务端会拒绝删除。
zh.profileInUse: 此配置仍被 Key 使用，请先解除绑定。

en.coverageHint: Reads the complete Key directory and saved model rules without contacting upstreams. Counts combine channel, Key, parent status and model permissions; they do not verify inference or real-time health.
en.modelUnion: Effective union: {{count}} models · All {{total}} Keys read
en.partialUnion: Confirmed union: at least {{count}} models · {{failed}} / {{total}} Keys could not be read
en.partialCoverage: {{count}} Key queries failed. Counts are incomplete; unknown is never shown as zero. Retry to complete them.
en.noPublishedModels: This channel has no published models.
en.profileInvalid: Enter a name, public HTTPS URL and query credential for a new account. User IDs allow up to 64 characters; amounts up to 12 decimal places; currency accepts letters, numbers and underscores.
en.channelTableHint: Local toggles edit channel permissions only. View each Key's model drawer for its effective state.

alert.low_balance: Upstream quota is below the configured threshold.
alert.exhausted: The upstream explicitly reported quota exhaustion.
alert.expiring: Upstream quota or subscription expires soon.
alert.query_failed: Upstream quota queries have repeatedly failed. Check the query configuration.

en.httpsHint: Use a public HTTPS URL without embedded credentials, query parameters or fragments.

usageError.unsupported_provider: This upstream platform is not supported yet.
usageError.profile_required: Create and bind a shared account query credential.
usageError.unsupported_endpoint: The upstream does not offer this query endpoint.
usageError.upstream_auth: The upstream rejected the query credential. Check its authorization.
usageError.upstream_rate_limited: The upstream limited query frequency. Try again later.
usageError.upstream_unavailable: The upstream is unavailable. Last successful values are preserved.
usageError.invalid_upstream_response: The upstream response was not recognized. The snapshot was preserved.
usageError.configuration_changed: Configuration changed during the query. Retry with the new configuration.
usageError.refresh_in_progress: A refresh is already running. The latest snapshot is shown.
usageError.query_failed: The query failed. Please retry later.

en.channelModelRefreshHint: Keys without independently saved rules use this refresh default. Off disables background refresh. Interval: 300–2592000 seconds.
en.keyModelRefreshHint: Saving creates independent refresh settings. Off overrides the channel default. Inheriting model access does not change this setting. Interval: 300–2592000 seconds.
en.usageIntervalHint: Off disables background refresh. When enabled, use 60–604800 seconds.
en.channelUsageHint: Keys without independent query settings inherit this platform, shared account, refresh interval and low quota settings.
en.usageInherited: Currently inherits channel defaults. Saving creates independent settings for this Key.
en.usageOverride: This Key uses independent settings. Disabling refresh also overrides the channel default.
en.channelPolicyHint: Match the final upstream model name across the channel. A Key cannot override a channel denial or expand its published model range.
en.keyPolicyHint: Existing Keys inherit the channel. Names are case-sensitive. Manual disable takes precedence, together with channel and parent credential rules.
en.emptyAllowlist: One model per line. An empty allowlist blocks every model.
en.namesHint: One case-sensitive upstream name per line. This list adds no restrictions in inherit mode.
en.noModels: No matching models. Fetch upstream models or add names manually.
en.discoveryEvidence: Listing a model does not verify inference. Fetching preserves saved rules; new models need explicit permission and remain within the published channel range.
en.emptyDiscovery: The upstream returned a complete empty list. Local rules are preserved. Save an empty allowlist explicitly to deny all models.
en.autoAddHint: Applies to allowlists only; manual disables are preserved.
en.intervalHint: Off disables background refresh. When enabled, use 60–2592000 seconds.
en.discoveryFailed: Discovery failed. Previous observations and local rules are preserved.
en.error: The action failed. Your input is preserved; please retry.
en.conflict: Another action updated this configuration. Reload before editing; your draft will not overwrite the newer version automatically.
en.forbidden: Your account does not have management access.
en.invalid: Check model names, list size, numeric values and refresh interval.
en.sharedHint: This belongs to a shared upstream account. Bound Keys share one snapshot; do not add their balances together.
en.unsupportedUsage: This platform or query mode does not support quota lookup. Check the platform and account configuration below.
en.failedUsage: The upstream query failed. Last successful values remain visible; unknown or stale data is never displayed as zero.
en.usageHint: Values retain their upstream scope and unit. The site wallet and locally billed usage are separate. A background query failure does not disable a Key.
en.providerHint: Configure the management platform separately from inference. OpenAI compatibility does not identify a New API platform.
en.profileMissing: The previous shared account is unavailable. Select another profile.
en.conversionHint: Set only when the upstream conversion is known. Leave blank to preserve its original unit.
en.lowThresholdHint: Uses the returned remaining quota unit. Leave blank to disable alerts; do not infer from the site wallet unit.
en.pauseHint: Only fresh, explicit exhaustion can pause traffic. Unknown, failed and stale snapshots do not. Recovery removes the quota pause independently of manual disable.
en.profileHint: Use a separate read-only query credential, reusable by Keys from the same account. It is encrypted and never returned after saving.
en.secretPreserved: A credential is configured. Leave blank to preserve it, or enter a replacement.
en.secretRequired: A read-only query credential is required when creating a profile.
en.deleteProfileHint: Deletion stops future queries. The server rejects deletion while Keys still reference this profile.
en.profileInUse: Keys still use this profile. Remove their bindings first.
